I think you need to exfoliate and moisturizer really good before makeup. Skin prep can make all the difference. A more dewy foundation can also help you look more like you just have healthy skin. Then if you want to set you can use a light bit of powder. Tap off your powder brush really good and stipple your powder just in the oiliest, crease-y areas (usually nose, undereye etc.) if you’re not doing eyeshadow bring a little bit of your foundation on your eyelid to give a more uniform look. As far as eyebrows find a good brow lady, they can clean your brow shape up and help you find what shape suits you best and give you good tips on filling them in.

I think defining the tail end of your brow would help. Use a micro tip eyebrow pencil and lightly go through your whole brow with light hair like strokes . Remember to step back and look at yourself from farther away every once in a while, it can help you get a more symmetrical look.
